variants.user_notes: Programming writes the FPGA's SRAM, so the design is lost at power-off. A ULX3S whose USB chip has no ULX3S name, or only an early name without the FPGA size, matches every ULX3S size.
variants.maintainer_notes: Moved from fujprog, which is legacy, to openFPGALoader's ulx3s board, writing SRAM as fujprog did. Not tried on hardware. USB filter (2026-11-05): the ULX3S's FT231X is programmed with a product name that gives the FPGA size and board revision, such as "ULX3S FPGA 85K v3.0.8": kost/fujprog fujprog.c (cable_hw_map, compared for equality) lists 12K to 85K for v2.1.2, v3.0.3, v3.0.7 and v3.0.8, and the early names "ULX3S FPGA board" and "ULX3S FPGA v1.7" without a size; intergalaktik/ulx3s-bin README sets it with ftx_prog (manufacturer FER-RADIONA-EMARD). Also accepts the FT231X's factory name, for a board whose chip was never named.

requires.name: wifi_gpio0
requires.why: GPIO0 of the board's ESP32 WiFi module: held low, it makes the ESP32 reset the board.
